day_shape: 76 items: CENTCOM says IRGC ballistic missiles at US bases all intercepted, Jordan downs five Iranian missiles, Hashd al-Shaabi claims US-Saudi strikes on Iraqi bases killed 10, Oman-Iran Hormuz talks advance, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: IRGC missile salvo at US bases
threads.summary: CENTCOM said IRGC forces launched multiple ballistic missiles at US bases in the Middle East at 5:45pm ET and all were intercepted. Jordanian state news reported air defences shot down five Iranian missiles early Wednesday.

threads.label: Strikes on Hashd al-Shaabi in Iraq
threads.summary: Hashd al-Shaabi said via IRIB and Defa Press that US and Saudi aerial attacks hit its bases in Nineveh, with the martyr toll rising to 10 and six wounded. Saudi Arabia's foreign ministry separately condemned drone attacks by Iran-backed militias in Iraq, and Jerusalem Post reported three drones intercepted over Jordan were likely launched by PMF.

threads.label: Hormuz shipping talks with Oman
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Oman proposed joint 50-50 management of the Strait of Hormuz with voluntary shipping fees, and Iran International said Tehran rejected the 50-50 split while offering an alternative route. CENTCOM said over 20 US Navy warships enforce its blockade, having redirected 18, disabled 2 and boarded 2 commercial vessels; Defa Press quoted Admiral Sayyari claiming complete Iranian control of the strait.

threads.label: Ukraine-Iran Caspian ship fallout
threads.summary: Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported Tehran considered attacking a Ukrainian Black Sea port after Ukraine's strike on an Iranian ship killed a sailor but opted against retaliation following diplomacy. Ukraine's Foreign Minister Sybiha said he called Iran's Araghchi to warn against escalation, while the Kremlin called the strike an assault on Iran.

threads.label: Netanyahu-Trump Washington meeting
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Netanyahu's flight to Washington took off discreetly citing an Iranian threat, and Trump hosted him alongside Zelensky to discuss the Iran and Ukraine wars. Trump reiterated threats against Iran's Pickaxe Mountain; Defence Minister Katz said US jets and bombers had struck Iran from Israeli bases; Iran expects up to 400 Chinese shoulder-fired air-defence launchers within weeks.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted an audio reply to a letter of allegiance from Hezbollah's secretary-general and fighters, plus statements on national unity and on economic priorities for parliament. Defa Press ran tributes to Martyr Hajizadeh from General Safavi and IRIB confirmed the martyrdom of Su-24 pilot Brigadier General Majid Kazemi.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon and Gaza incidents
threads.summary: The IDF said troops fired on a suspect approaching them in Ras al-Bayada, southern Lebanon, and reported a mistaken interceptor launch at Israeli artillery fire; separately weapons caches were found in the Security Zone. In Gaza, the IDF said a Khan Younis strike killed Islamic Jihad Nukhba commander Muhammad Khalil Aslam, and Hamas sent a delegation to Egypt on ceasefire talks.
